title: better crosshair by me
description: this resource makes the Crosshair gray and white
body:
Minimalistic resource pack that replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a smooth gray-to-white gradient fade. The design is made to stay clean and barely distracting while still being clearly visible in any environment.

This crosshair uses a soft blending style, giving a modern “glow fade” effect instead of a solid color, making it perfect for PvP, survival, and building.

🧊 Features
Smooth gray ↔ white gradient crosshair
Clean and minimal design (vanilla-friendly style)
Better visibility on both dark and bright blocks
Lightweight — only changes crosshair texture
No gameplay changes, purely visual
